verdict.rationale: Florida DOR documents a remote sign-in path using a User ID and Password for eFile and Pay (fl-dor-docs-10), with an online forgot-ID/password flow (fl-dor-docs-14, fl-dor-docs-18). The probe confirms the business-tax application serves a web login shell (fl-dor-probe-3). Nothing in the evidence points to biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN sent by mail, but MFA is never documented and the account-enrollment and credential-issuance path is not shown. Missing for 10: documented MFA on sign-in, evidence that initial enrollment or credential issuance avoids mailed PINs or in-person steps, hands-on corroboration of the login flow.
